title: flybot/01/cmd/manual
description: Manual wheel command from a dashboard tab, QoS 0, not retained, 10 Hz while driving, obeyed only in manual mode. Same fields as cmd/motor plus src (the tab's sender name). Contract section 3.5.

up.description: Sender uptime, ms (time since the tab loaded).

l.description: Left wheel, -1.0 full reverse to +1.0 full forward (2 dp).

r.description: Right wheel, -1.0 full reverse to +1.0 full forward (2 dp).

rs.description: seq of the newest sensors message this tab has received, 0 if none.

src.description: Dashboard tab sender name, generated at page load.
